THE PRICE SIGNAL

One scalar.
Two kinds of evidence.

Fine-tuned E5 returns predicted_text_price in dollars. LightGBM then combines it with year, mileage and categorical car attributes.

The public model checkpoint is a starting point. It must be fine-tuned on pricing targets before this stack can give estimates.

How the estimate is learned

01

Fine-tune on text

embaas/sentence-transformers-multilingual-e5-base

Every transformer weight and a regression head learn standardized log1p(price) from descriptions only. Long text uses multiple 512-token chunks, up to 8,000 characters.

02

Cross-fit the signal

Three training folds generate held-out text prices. A listing’s text-price feature is produced by a model that never saw that listing’s target.

The final text model learns from all training rows. Filtering is applied only to LightGBM training rows; validation and test stay intact.

03

Combine with LightGBM

LightGBM uses the text-price scalar and car fields. The 6-model Huber grid uses Isolation Forest auto mode, dollar/log targets and Huber thresholds 0.5, 0.9 and 1.5. Validation selects the winner.
